qxb-sat-1.webp.zh: 在卫星图上，艾克斯莱米勒机场（QXB）与周围的城镇、农田与植被连成一片。
qxb-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, Aix Les Milles airport (QXB) blends into the surrounding town, farmland and vegetation.

qxb-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 一架白色小型单发飞机滑行经过低矮的塔台和航站楼，灰色的阴云压在草地上空。
qxb-chatgpt-01.webp.en: A small white single-engine aircraft taxies past a low control tower and terminal buildings under a flat grey sky.

qxb-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 航拍画面中，两条跑道在田野间交叉，机坪与机库沿跑道一侧排开。
qxb-chatgpt-02.webp.en: In this aerial view two runways cross amid farmland, with the apron and hangars lined up along one side.

qxb-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 阳光下，一排白色轻型飞机整齐停放在机坪上，远处可见塔台与树线。
qxb-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A neat row of white light aircraft stands on the apron in bright sun, with the control tower and a treeline behind.

qxb-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 米黄色的塔台立在低矮的航站楼中央，两侧是机库，背后是灰绿色的丘陵。
qxb-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A cream-coloured control tower rises from the middle of a low terminal, flanked by hangars beneath bare grey hills.

qxb-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰，铁路线、草地与秋色的树木围在机场边缘，远处是起伏的山丘。
qxb-chatgpt-05.webp.en: From the air, a railway line, meadow and autumn trees border the airfield, with low hills fading into the distance.

qxb-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 夕阳贴着地平线，一架红白涂装的特技飞机停在跑道旁，座舱映着金光。
qxb-chatgpt-06.webp.en: The sun sits on the horizon as a red-and-white aerobatic aircraft waits beside the runway, its canopy catching the glow.
